en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hajjal, from Sa’albat Bin Maymoun, from Muhammad Bin Qays who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the blind, is his testimony allowed?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, when it is proved’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hajjal from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Qays who has narrated the following:
“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the testimony of a blind man if it is admissible. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is admissible if he has preserved it.’”
